note: Session flags, set in a prompt as #Name=YES or #Name=NO. Ported from the legacy FRAMEWORK-FEATURE-FLAGS.md. 'effect' describes the non-default value.
nonNegotiable: These never change with any flag: plan approval before code, DONE only with verification evidence, confirmation before irreversible actions.

flags.name: ChatOutput
flags.effect: suppress ordinary narration, commentary and preambles

flags.name: DocumentCreation
flags.effect: save substantial output (plan, spec, analysis) to a file instead of chat only

flags.name: BetterExplanation
flags.effect: plain-language explanation with a Mermaid diagram for every process, flow or decision, plus the real result or proof

flags.name: PseudoCode
flags.effect: express logic in the WH-word pseudo-code DSL (WHAT/WHERE/WHEN/WHY/WHO/HOW/IF-THEN/DO/WHILE) alongside real code

flags.name: GroundWork
flags.effect: before the answer, explain the groundwork (WHAT/WHY/HOW/WHERE/WHO, root cause, core concepts), researched and shown with proof

flags.name: FlowCharts
flags.effect: diagram every path of a flow, process or plan end to end

flags.name: AskForClarifications
flags.effect: ask clarifying questions up front until both the ask and the plan are clear

flags.name: BeProActive
flags.effect: for every non-trivial task, visibly run ANALYZE, EXPLORE, MAP POSSIBILITIES, VERIFY, EXECUTE, REPORT with proof, SUGGEST NEXT

flags.name: ExplainWithResults
flags.effect: every answer shows What I tried, What happened (verbatim output), What it means, What I concluded

flags.name: AgentsFactory
flags.effect: fan out subagents for genuinely independent subtasks (2-4x token cost); shared reasoning stays inline
